key_concepts: White light is a mixture of many colors
The visible light colors can be remembered as ROYGBIV
Dispersion is the separation of white light into its component colors by refraction
A prism disperses white light into red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet
Water droplets can act as tiny prisms
Rainbows form through reflection and refraction of sunlight in water droplets
Red has the longest wavelength and lowest frequency among visible colors
Violet has the shortest wavelength and highest frequency among visible colors
Violet has the greatest energy and red has the least energy among visible colors
Frequency and energy of light increase together
Frequency and wavelength are inversely related
Red is the least bent color and violet is the most bent color
